exposure: Intrauterine injection of VNIITU-1 PVP molded carbon sorbent
cohort: 23 women who had recently given birth and were diagnosed with postpartum endometritis and cesarean scar defect.
finding: A comprehensive treatment approach, including surgery and a specific therapy regimen, for postpartum endometritis and cesarean scar defect reduced hysterectomy rates and improved healing indicators like white blood cell count and C-reactive protein levels.
mod_finding: The study focuses on postpartum endometritis after cesarean section, suggesting that the comprehensive treatment approach may be particularly beneficial for this group.
